title: Era vs Era: The Art of the Promo

segments.voice: Wrestling has changed. But has it lost its soul?
Back in the day, it was one man, one microphone, and a promo you never forgot.
No pyro. No cinematic video packages. Just charisma that made you believe every word.
When Flair said to be the man, you gotta beat the man, a whole generation believed him.
Today, WWE tells stories on a whole different level.
Years-long sagas. Like Cody Rhodes finally finishing his father's story at WrestleMania.
Same family. Two eras. Two different ways to make you feel it.
So which era made you believe? Classic, or modern?

caption:
ONE MICROPHONE. TWO GENERATIONS. ONE BIG QUESTION.
Back in the day, one promo could make a rivalry feel personal. Today, WWE gives us years-long sagas, cinematic moments and stories like Cody finishing what Dusty started.
Has modern wrestling lost something along the way, or has it simply grown into something bigger?
CLASSIC or MODERN? Drop your answer in the comments.
